ayahs.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High
ayahs.e2: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High
and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly

ayahs.en: And who brings out the pasture

ayahs.e2: then reduces it to withered chaff

ayahs.en: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget
ayahs.e2: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
ayahs.en: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden
ayahs.e2: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden
ayahs.tr: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa

ayahs.en: And We will ease you toward ease
ayahs.e2: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease

ayahs.en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit
ayahs.e2: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺

ayahs.en: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded
ayahs.e2: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺

ayahs.en: But the wretched one will avoid it
ayahs.e2: But it will be shunned by the most wretched

ayahs.en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire
ayahs.e2: who will burn in the greatest Fire

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
ayahs.e2: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die
ayahs.tr: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

ayahs.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
ayahs.e2: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves

ayahs.en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
ayahs.e2: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray

ayahs.en: But you prefer the worldly life
ayahs.e2: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world

ayahs.en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring
ayahs.e2: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting

ayahs.en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures
ayahs.e2: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
ayahs.tr: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa

ayahs.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses
ayahs.e2: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses
